messages:
Jules (Vendor): Hi team — sending invoice INV-2026-045 for Feb. It's consolidated for 3 orders. PDF: https://invoices.vendorco.com/INV-2026-045 :paperclip:
Lina (Finance Ops): Thanks Jules. The PDF doesn't show PO numbers. We need PO(s) or cost centers to route approvals and for PO-match rules.
Jules (Vendor): Sorry — we merged three orders at billing. The underlying POs are 4501, 4502, 4503. Our billing system outputs one file by default.
Matt (AP): That will fail automated PO matching and hit manual review, which delays payment. Can you split into three invoices aligned to each PO?
Jules (Vendor): We can split and reissue. ETA about 2 business days. Will that work?
Anna (Procurement): 2 days acceptable. Also need GL codes per PO and approvers. @Lina please confirm who approves 4502.
Lina (Finance Ops): Noted. @Anna, can you provide GL/approver mapping for all three?
Anna (Procurement): Mapping below:
```
4501 -> GL 6003 (Cloud Services) -> Approver: @Matt
4502 -> GL 6100 (Professional Services) -> Approver: @Lina
4503 -> GL 6200 (Hardware) -> Approver: @Procurement Team
```
Please ask vendor to include PO in invoice header and line-level PO ref if possible.
Matt (AP): Short-term workaround if vendor can't split quickly: we can create a temporary umbrella PO so AP can clear payment for amount under that umbrella. Procurement must approve creation of TEMP PO.
Anna (Procurement): I can raise a TEMP PO (TEMP-9001). We need vendor to accept payment to that TEMP PO and sign an acknowledgement that they will reissue per-PO invoices and reconcile within 48 hours.
Jules (Vendor): We can sign. Please send the acknowledgement template and TEMP PO details. We'll send signed PDF and follow-up split invoices in 48h.
Lina (Finance Ops): Template here: https://redwood.internal/docs/ap/vendor-ack-template.docx. Vendor, please name reissued files as INV-2026-045_4501.pdf etc to help OCR.
AP-bot: Invoice INV-2026-045 attached for VendorCo — total $34,500 — status: pending_manual_review.
Jules (Vendor): Quick question: can a partial payment be processed for the hardware line (4503, $10,000) now, provided we sign the statement?
Anna (Procurement): Yes, if vendor signs and we get mapping in writing: 
```
4503 -> $10,000 -> GL 6200 -> Approver: @Lina
```
AP can process that line once TEMP-9001 is in place or when vendor provides signed ack.
Matt (AP): I'll place a hold and add the note: "INV-2026-045 — awaiting split or TEMP PO". Will set follow-up reminder in Coupa for 3 days. Ping me when TEMP-9001 is live.
Anna (Procurement): TEMP-9001 creation in progress, should be active within ~1 hour.
Jules (Vendor): We'll sign and return the ack PDF within the hour and follow up with split invoices within 48 hours.
Lina (Finance Ops): Action items: 1) @Anna create TEMP-9001; 2) @Jules send signed vendor ack; 3) @Matt hold invoice and tag AP; 4) vendor to submit split invoices within 48h.
Matt (AP): Confirmed. Marking as pending and assigning manual review to AP queue.
Jules (Vendor): Thanks for the quick coordination.
Lina (Finance Ops): Thanks all :thumbsup:
